svg.title: Smart Watering IoT — System Architecture
svg.desc: Three-tier architecture: Field/Edge layer with sensors and ESP32, Cloud layer with ThingSpeak and ML pipeline, and Application layer with dashboard and notifications.

g.text: ESP32 DevKit v1 — sensors, relay, local logic

g.text: ESP32 — edge processing, 30s upload cycle, threshold-based pump trigger
